7. Size search runs twice per cut table (run_sql_display_line and formatter) [src/sqllens/_table_payload.py:223-260]. (raised by 1/6 agents: requesting-code-review)
8. '1 rows' grammar when M == 1 in undisplayable text [src/sqllens/tools/_format.py:1200-1204]. (raised by 1/6 agents: requesting-code-review)
